# King West Dentistry

> Specialist dental practice offering comprehensive preventive, restorative, cosmetic, and endodontic services in Downtown Toronto led by Dr. Alireza Golabchifar.

King West Dentistry is a full-service dental practice located in Downtown Toronto specializing in both general and cosmetic dentistry with advanced CEREC CAD/CAM technology. The practice offers same-day restorations, endodontic microsurgery, and preventive care services.
